title: index@1
description: The wiki's index: upsert(claims), search(query) giving hits that each cite their claim, page, quote and source, dropSource(source) and rebuild(claims) from the pages. It is never the source of truth; the hub reads each hit's provenance from the claim records.

slot.description: The hub slot the fill declares itself for.

revision.description: The kit revision the fill was built against.
